Title: Login with valid standard_user credentials
Steps:
1. Enter 'standard_user' in Username
2. Enter 'secret_sauce' in Password
3. Click 'Login'
Expected Result: User is redirected to /inventory.html and product catalog is visible

Title: Login attempt with locked_out_user
Expected Result: Error banner appears: 'Epic sadface: Sorry, this user has been locked out.'

Title: Login with invalid password
Expected Result: Error banner appears indicating username and password do not match

Title: Login with empty Username field
Expected Result: Validation error: 'Epic sadface: Username is required'

Title: Login with empty Password field
Expected Result: Validation error: 'Epic sadface: Password is required'

Title: Logout clears user session
Steps:
1. Open left burger menu
2. Click 'Logout'
3. Try opening /inventory.html directly
Expected Result: User is returned to login page and blocked from accessing inventory

Title: Sort products by Price (low to high)
Steps:
1. Click sort dropdown
2. Select 'Price (low to high)'
Expected Result: First item is $7.99 (Sauce Labs Onesie), last item is $49.99 (Fleece Jacket)

Title: Sort products by Name (Z to A)
Steps:
1. Click sort dropdown
2. Select 'Name (Z to A)'
Expected Result: Products reorder strictly descending from Z to A

Title: Add single product to cart and verify badge
Preconditions: Logged in as standard_user, cart is empty
Steps:
1. Click 'Add to cart' on Sauce Labs Backpack
2. Check cart icon badge
Expected Result: Button changes to 'Remove' and cart badge displays '1'

Title: Remove product from cart on Cart page
Steps:
1. Click cart icon
2. Click 'Remove' next to item
Expected Result: Item is removed from list and cart badge disappears

Title: Complete end-to-end checkout with 2 items
Steps:
1. Open Cart -> Click 'Checkout'
2. Fill First Name, Last Name, Postal Code -> 'Continue'
3. Verify subtotal $39.98 + 8% tax $3.20 = $43.18
4. Click 'Finish'
Expected Result: Confirmation page 'Thank you for your order!' is shown and cart is empty

Title: Checkout Step 1 with missing Postal Code
Preconditions: 1 item in cart, on Checkout Step 1
Steps:
1. Enter First Name 'Anton' and Last Name 'Zverkov'
2. Leave Postal Code empty
3. Click 'Continue'
Expected Result: Error message displayed: 'Error: Postal Code is required'

Title: Attempt checkout with empty cart
Preconditions: Logged in as standard_user, cart is empty (0 items)
Steps:
1. Open Cart page
2. Click 'Checkout'
3. Fill valid form and click 'Continue' -> 'Finish'
Expected Result: Expected: Checkout button disabled or error shown. Actual: Order completes with $0.00 (BUG-002)

Title: Verify product sorting for problem_user
Steps:
1. Open sort dropdown
2. Select 'Price (low to high)'
Expected Result: Expected: Products sort by ascending price. Actual: Order does not change (BUG-001)

Title: Verify unique product images in catalog for problem_user
Steps:
1. Inspect all 6 product thumbnails
2. Check image URLs in Chrome DevTools Elements tab
Expected Result: Expected: Each product shows its matching image. Actual: All products display the same placeholder dog image (BUG-003)
